# Standalone executable preparation tool

Copied unchanged from the user-supplied `the-3rd-birthday-recomp-master.zip`,
directory `runtime/third_party/eboot_decrypt`. The upstream commit of this
branch archive has not been independently identified.

Upstream: https://github.com/BasedYuki/the-3rd-birthday-recomp

See README.md for per-component origins and licenses: PPSSPP PrxDecrypter
(GPL-2.0-or-later), libkirk (GPL-3.0-or-later) and the utility wrapper.
The executable as a whole is GPL-3.0-or-later. Source and original notices
are retained. This is an independent local preparation utility and is not
linked into the DIVA runtime. No release package has been produced.

The K-On project remains the primary runtime/recompiler base. This utility
only prepares the original Japanese executable for analysis.
